title: judge review request
description: Written to $JUDGE_REVIEW_DIR/queue/<id>.json by hooks (C1 plan, C2 gate, C4 completion) and the watcher (C6 runaway). See judge/CONTRACT.md.

not_before.description: optional: run_judge.py --pending leaves the request queued until this UTC time (plan debounce, #34)

detail.description: free-form hook detail; in the bundle manifest's request copy the collector adds unconfirmed_paths (changed_paths no tool event of the session confirms) and unconfirmed_paths_total

sha.description: git tree id of judge/ (index), or the first line of judge/VERSION

code_version.description: optional: the judge code that wrote this request (lib/version.code_version, stamped by lib/queue.write_request); requests without it stay valid
